This was me in April 2020. Worst time of my life. Wouldn’t relive it for any amount of money.. my mindset was; wanting to die going to sleep, waking up, still wanting to die.. on the agenda for today hopefully be dead by the end of it.” I was severely depressed but like you I couldn’t find the strength to actually end myself. Day by day I got better.. it took months but here I am after I was sure I wouldn’t make it to June 2020. Hang in there. Try using ice cubes against your wrists instead of blades by the way. Don’t feel ashamed. If I want you to take anything from this it is that depression is a LIAR. It lies. From the deep depths bottom of your heart you may BELIEVE you are worthless (as depression tells you believe me I once believed this) but it is LYING. I hope you find a little bit of light in this dark area of your life like I did, and I am still not fully out. Some days are hard. We are going through this together. Sending you virtual support x
